t: AI smart glasses with a tiny color display, camera and open firmware.
steps: Order Halo from the Brilliant Labs online store.
Charge the glasses with the magnetic USB-C charger.
Read the Halo getting started guide in the Brilliant Labs docs.
Install the Python SDK from the brilliant_sdk repo on your computer.
Pair the glasses over Bluetooth and run the hello world example.
Edit the example to show your own text in the display.
Try the Flutter or Web Bluetooth SDK next.
